thread:
ana: Quick postmortem follow-up: recurring 99p latency spikes on /generate during peak bursts. Need owners and concrete dates for batching, SLO cohort, and dashboards/alerts.

tom: I can own batching/queue caps. Plan: split long-seq (>1300 tokens) into separate queue, cap batch size, add sampling for tail latencies. PR ETA: Wed EOD.

ricardo: I'll take alerts + dashboard. Split 95/99 alerts, add an error-budget burn panel (30m) and a model+route 99p panel. ETA: Thu morning.

pager-bot: Incident I-8001 created and linked to the postmortem (label=latency-pattern).

ana: ana here: please make SLO tweak cohort-based not global. ricardo, can you draft the RFC with rollback gates and a comms checklist?

ricardo: Yep. Draft will include rollback gate: 99p < 1.1s for 3h and error-budget burn < 1.5x for 6h. RFC ETA: Fri morning.

tom: Canary plan after PR merge: 24h at 10% then 24h at 30% if stable. Metrics to watch: 99p by model, queue wait, CPU/GPU util.

ana: Ownership summary: batching/canary = tom; alerts/dashboard = ricardo; SLO cohort & comms = ana. I'll own cross-team notifications and I-8001 milestones. Weekly ops sync Mon 10:00 to review canary telemetry and error-budget trajectory. Tag any pages "latency-pattern" for aggregation.

ricardo: Posted staging dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/zzzz999/latency-burn (staging).

tom: PR link: https://git.internal/r/infra/opt-batcher/pulls/199.

ana: Thanks all, keep updates short in this thread.
